content.title: Basketball - 2025-26 NBA Awards: Full list of winners and finalists
content.text: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Nikola Jokić and Victor Wembanyama are vying to be crowned this season's Most Valuable Player, but who are the other winners of the top NBA honours?Picture by Matthew Stockman/Getty ImagesBy Olympics.comUpdated on 22 April 2026 22:08 GMT+03 min readWith the NBA playoffs now upon us, the winners of the top regular-season awards are starting to be announced. The finalists for the seven major individual honours were revealed on Sunday 19 April, with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander in the running to be crowned Most Valuable Player for the second year running, up against Nikola Jokić and Victor Wembanyama. Other awards include Rookie of the Year and Coach of the Year, with the recipients of the respective prizes being named from Monday 20 April. Here, Olympics.com brings you the full list of the 2025-26 NBA Awards winners and the schedule of when the remaining recipients will be announced.Basketball | Men's Gold Medal Game | France v USA | Paris 2024 HighlightsUSA win their fifth Men's Basketball Gold in a row.2025-26 NBA Awards: Winners NBA Defensive Player of the Year Winner: Victor Wembanyama (San Antonio Spurs). Finalists: Chet Holmgren (Oklahoma City Thunder), Ausar Thompson (Detroit Pistons), Victor Wembanyama (San Antonio Spurs).NBA Clutch Player of the Year Winner: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (Oklahoma City Thunder). Finalists: Anthony Edwards (Minnesota Timberwolves), Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (Oklahoma City Thunder), Jamal Murray (Denver Nuggets).NBA Sixth Man of the Year Winner: Keldon Johnson (San Antonio Spurs). Finalists: Tim Hardaway Jr. (Denver Nuggets), Jaime Jaquez Jr. (Miami Heat), Keldon Johnson (San Antonio Spurs).NBA Sportsmanship Award Winner: Announced Thursday 23 April Finalists: Bam Adebayo (Miami Heat), Harrison Barnes (San Antonio Spurs), Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (Oklahoma City Thunder), Al Horford (Golden State Warriors), T. J. McConnell (Indiana Pacers), Derrick White (Boston Celtics)NBA Most Improved Player Winner: Announced Friday 24 April Finalists: Nickeil Alexander-Walker (Atlanta Hawks), Deni Avdija (Portland Trail Blazers), Jalen Duren (Detroit Pistons)NBA Most Valuable Player Winner: Announcement date unknown Finalists: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (Oklahoma City Thunder), Nikola Jokić (Denver Nuggets), Victor Wembanyama (San Antonio Spurs)Picture by Ezra Shaw/Getty ImagesVictor Wembanyama is one of the three finalists for this year's MVP awardNBA Rookie of the Year Winner: Announcement date unknown Finalists: VJ Edgecombe (Philadelphia 76ers), Cooper Flagg (Dallas Mavericks), Kon Knueppel (Charlotte Hornets)NBA Coach of the Year Winner: Announcement date unknown Finalists: J.B.
